UPDATE delivery_payment_reservations
            SET
                merchant_payout_cents = $1,
                commission_cents = $2,
                commission_rate = $3,
                merchant_paid_at = NOW(),
                client_payment_method = $4,
                merchant_payment_method = $5,
                payout_method_used = $6,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE delivery_id = $7
